freshness: Expanded coverage of already-current September snapshots; no new release or benchmark execution

metadata.freshness: same source release as existing gallery; 228 configurations available vs 6 selected
metadata.metric_notes: Primary chart should use all-attempt clear-pushback percentage. Dashboard default excludes candidate refusals; both provided explicitly. avg_score is judge-average 0–2, not a percent. Errors remain in denominator. No valid-question false-rejection test.
metadata.cost_time_notes: Candidate reported costs and latency only; preserve per-model coverage. Mean cost divides cost total by cost-covered responses, not all 100 when coverage missing. Not a billed invoice. Excludes judge cost. Latency includes request processing/retries, not human end-to-end workflow time.

protocol.evaluation_track: V2, 100 invalid-premise prompts, 13 techniques; one run per model-effort
protocol.metric: Clear-pushback / all 100 attempts; refusals remain in denominator
protocol.judge_failure_policy: Up to three attempts for failed judge; mean of two valid judgments allowed after exhaustion; refusals deliberately ungraded
protocol.judge_bucket_rule: Half-up rounding of mean judge score; bucket 2 is clear pushback
protocol.tools: Stateless single-turn text requests through OpenRouter; no agent tool-use phase in inspected collector
protocol.reasoning_efforts: Exact @reasoning suffix per result; not harmonized across vendors

current_durable_config.historical_receipt_status: Current pinned config and technical guide support configured setup; no per-request payload retained in selected artifacts

protocol.latency_definition: response_latency_ms timer surrounds collect_one request construction/API call/retries/response processing; excludes external task-queue wait before collect_one, judging and whole-evaluation completion. Includes API/network/provider wait and any retries inside that call; not pure model inference.
protocol.cost_definition: Provider-reported response_cost_usd summed for covered candidate responses; excludes judge calls, infrastructure and potentially separate retries; not independently invoice-reconciled
protocol.pricing_date_status: No static rate-card effective date used; telemetry captured at per-response evaluation times
protocol.comparability_status: Shared fixed V2 prompt snapshot and named judging panel; retain effort, coverage and collection dates
limitations: Invalid-premise detection is not valid-question rejection accuracy
LLM judges are noisy; selected rows include two-judge fallback
One pass through fixed 100 questions, no replicate CI
Provider snapshots are aliases, not immutable weight versions
Compare all-attempt scores only to all-attempt scores
